name: Twin Moons
design_intent: OWNER 2026-07-18: 'another one where maybe we are orbiting 2 moons'. Two round trampoline PLANETOIDS (body_r 210, meta round -> true radial bounce normals) each with its own constant radial field (g=1400, r=820 — fields deliberately DON'T overlap: the ~330px corridor between them is neutral global-down space, so crossing moons means committing to a fall). Standing anywhere on a moon is a floor (gravity-relative underside guard); knockback that clears a field drops victims into global-down gravity and out the bottom blast line — the classic ring-out preserved in space. Two small trampoline perches float high in the neutral column (contested powerup ground; reachable by trampoline apex 270 off either moon's north pole + a short boost). Spawns: north pole of each moon + the two perches. Space palette + stars; each source draws its faint field-extent ring.
